log.title: ▾ Activity log
firstrun.intro: TM Concept keeps everything in an encrypted database on this computer. Start fresh, or bring your data back from a backup file (possible only now, before any data exists).
firstrun.restore.hint: Brings back profiles, concepts, video records and settings from a .tmcbak file.
firstrun.protection.keyring: The database key is protected by this computer's keyring and opens by itself when you sign in.
firstrun.protection.nokeyring: No keyring was found on this computer: the database is protected with a master password asked at every start.
firstrun.use_master_password: Ask for a master password at every start instead
password.too_short: The password must be at least {0} characters.
password.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
password.forgotten_warning: If you forget this password, nobody can recover the data.
backup.password.title: Backup password (required)
backup.password.explain: A backup is written every day (the last ten are kept) and is encrypted with this password. A backup cannot be opened without it. API keys are never put in a backup.
backup.password.change_explain: New backups use the new password; older backup files still open with the old one.
backup.explain: Backups are written once a day at the first start and the last ten are kept in the backup folder. Only the database is backed up (without API keys); videos and sample images stay in your documents folder. You can copy backup files to another disk yourself.
backup.no_password: No backup password is set; no backup was written. Set one in Settings → Backup.
restore.keys_note: API keys are not in backups: enter them again in Settings → Keys after the restore.
restore.missing: Choose a backup file and type its password.
restore.wrong_password: The backup password is wrong, or the file is damaged.
restore.done: Backup restored: {0} profiles, {1} concepts, {2} videos. Enter your API keys again in Settings → Keys.
unlock.title: Open TM Concept
unlock.automatic_failed: The database key could not be opened automatically: {0}
unlock.forgotten: A forgotten master password cannot be recovered. To start over (or to load a backup), close the app and move the data folder away; the README explains where it is.
settings.notifications.enabled: Show a notification at the bottom right when a job finishes or fails
